content: Bininj Nawu Kabimarnekele God Wanjh Kadjalnjilngmakmen.
Ngudda bininj bu yimarnekele Yawey dja mak yibolhkadjung kore Yawey ngunbukkan, wanjh ngudda yidjalmarrmarr duninjh!
Kaluk Yawey ngunmarnekurduyime kunmak, dja yingun manme manbu ngudda ke kore yirrurrkmirri kubid ke, dja ngudda yidjalni kamak rowk.
Ngalbininjkobeng ke, wanjh kakurduyime kunmak rowk kore ngunehdi, dja bebeywurd ke wanjh kabirridjalmak rowk kore ngurridjarrkngun manme.
Bu kuhni nawu Yawey kabenmarnekurduyime bininj rowk nawu kabirrikelemen nuye.
Mah, ngadjare nawu Yawey ngunmarnekurduyime kunmak ke munguyh munguyh kore Zionbeh, ba bu yibolknan kukadjeh Jerusalem kadjalbolkmak kunbarnangarra rowk bu yidjaldarrkiddi.
Dja warridj yidjaldarrkid kunkuyeng ba bu yibendarrkidnan mawahmawah ke.
